ownRead.body:
## Read the current evidence

These views preserve the supplied documents’ classifications and attribution. A working website is not a reproduction of the cited experiments or a proof of the RRG extensions.

- [06 — Claim and evidence matrix](/research-status/proof-matrix/): status, evidence targets, contrary results and core impact.
- [07 — Emergent interaction channels](/evidence/interactions/): three distinct physical cases and the narrower effective-interaction question.
- [08 — Additional primary evidence](/evidence/additional/): all nine entries, their core-clause mapping, conditions and source-reported inspection limits.

## Effective-interaction records from 07

| Source case | Stable website record | Scope |
|---|---|---|
| Phonon-mediated attraction | :claim[UT-E10] | Appropriate conventional-superconductivity regime; effective attraction does not replace electromagnetism. |
| Spin-ice excitations | :claim[UT-E11] | Emergent quasiparticles and Coulomb-like interactions in correlated spin systems. |
| Background-field state | :claim[UT-E12] | Electroweak spectrum and interaction regime; not a derivation from RRG recursion. |

These examples motivate the proposed relation between organization, an effective interaction channel and further organization. The [07 source’s open boundary](/evidence/interactions/#5-what-remains-open) explicitly leaves fundamental-force unification unproved.

## Additional realizations from 08

The labels below are the source register’s E01–E09. The stable website IDs retain the UT prefix so the source-local labels do not become a second claim identity. Read each record for the actual reported evidence, scope, location and access limits.

| Source entry | Stable record | Reported realization |
|---|---|---|
| E01 | :claim[UT-E01] | Optical supramolecular structures in a pumped fibre laser. |
| E02 | :claim[UT-E02] | Heteronuclear soliton molecules in a driven microresonator. |
| E03 | :claim[UT-E03] | ATP-driven mechanochemical liposome feedback. |
| E04 | :claim[UT-E04] | Synthetic-compartment protein dynamics and deformation. |
| E05 | :claim[UT-E05] | Electrical signalling in bacterial biofilms. |
| E06 | :claim[UT-E06] | Coupled biofilms and nutrient time-sharing. |
| E07 | :claim[UT-E07] | Engineered hierarchical DNA-origami assembly. |
| E08 | :claim[UT-E08] | Self-organization in a pumped atom–cavity system. |
| E09 | :claim[UT-E09] | Symmetry-based cluster synchronization. |

The [original register’s mapping table](/evidence/additional/#what-the-added-evidence-supports) connects these entries to reciprocal influence, heterogeneous constituents, retained lower organization, further collective relationships, successive assembly and quantitative predictions. These are domain-specific realizations, not a common microscopic law. “Checked” in that register reports its authors’ inspections; this website does not claim those paper checks as its own.

Continue with [research status](/research-status/) or [open questions and failure tests](/open-problems/).
